QuestInfo.0: Become an honorary citizen of #eCommerci#k#n, the republic of trade in western Dawnveil.

0.0: Hello, #e#b#h0##k#n. Have you been to the #e#rCommerci Republic#k#n on the west coast of Dawnveil? I am sure someone of your means can get there easily. But I do need to give you one bit of information.\r\nDo you want to hear it?

yes.0: You can become a honorary citizen of the #b#eCommerci Republic#k#n. Go to Commerci in Dawnveil, collect Commerci emblems, do favors for Mayor Berry, catch bounty monsters, and participate in trades. These are all part of the #eCommerci Life#n\r\nYou will become a honorary Commerci Citizen if you live out each part of the Commerci Life 10 times.

no.0: It won't hurt to just hear me out, you know.

1.0: How did the Commerci Life feel for you?\r\nI hope you liked it, because you are now a #e#bhonorary citizen of the Commerci Republic#k#n!

yes.0: Congratulations! Now Commerci welcomes you as one of its own.
